title: Commercial credit intake → underwriting decision
description: Normalize a commercial credit application, assess repayment and collateral, resolve exceptions, and require accountable approval.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: commercial-credit-underwriting
  title: Commercial credit intake → underwriting decision
  description: Normalize a commercial credit application, independently assess repayment and collateral, resolve
    exceptions, and require accountable approval.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a traceable commercial credit decision whose applicant identity, requested structure,
    repayment capacity, collateral, covenants, and policy exceptions are explicitly supported.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - credit-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Application and supporting credit package
      summary: Borrower application, KYC evidence, financial profile, collateral, and requested facility.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - workflowFields
        properties:
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - applicant
              - requested_amount
              - loan_purpose
            properties:
              applicant: {}
              requested_amount: {}
              loan_purpose: {}
              collateral: {}
              financial_profile: {}
              kyc_profile: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: normalize
      kind: agent
      name: Normalize application and financial evidence
      templateRef: fin-04
      role: Financial evidence analyst preserving period, unit, source, and applicant identity.
      prompt: Extract cited financial facts at the correct period, unit, basis, and consolidation scope.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: credit-review
      kind: agent
      name: Independent credit risk assessment
      templateRef: fin-06
      role: Credit risk analyst assessing repayment capacity, structure, collateral, covenants, and downside
        liquidity.
      prompt: Assess repayment capacity, structure, collateral, covenants, downside liquidity, and concentration
        risk.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: decision-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Credit package completeness gate
      role: Independent credit policy reviewer
      prompt: Pass only when borrower identity, requested structure, repayment capacity, collateral support,
        covenants, exceptions, and approval conditions are traceable to supplied evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.9
    - id: credit-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Authorized credit officer approves the decision
      summary: Confirm facility structure, risk rating, exceptions, conditions, and approval authority.
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved credit decision and conditions register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: normalize
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: normalize
      to: credit-review
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: credit-review
      to: decision-gate
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: decision-gate
      to: credit-approval
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: credit-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
